_readme: Photo and video registry. Each entry is one image slot on the site. To replace a wireframe placeholder, save the photo at assets/images/<file> and rebuild: the build detects the file and swaps the placeholder for the real image automatically. PHOTO-GUIDE.md is generated from this file.

hero-landscape.title: Texas Landscape — Hero Backdrop (Optional)
hero-landscape.description: A wide, softly lit North Texas landscape: live oaks, open grassland or a quiet field at early morning or golden hour. Must be our own photograph or properly licensed.
hero-landscape.crop: Keep the horizon in the lower third and the left half calm — the headline sits over the left side. Avoid people and buildings. On phones the image is cropped to the centre.
hero-landscape.alt: Live oak trees in soft morning light across open North Texas grassland
hero-landscape.usedOn: Home (hero). Until supplied, an illustrated landscape is shown.

portrait-professional.title: Dr. Rainey — Professional Portrait
portrait-professional.description: Natural, approachable portrait of Dr. Rainey in soft window light. Waist-up, looking toward the camera. Warm neutral background; white coat optional.
portrait-professional.crop: Vertical 4:5. Eyes roughly one-third from the top, a little space above the head. Keep shoulders inside the frame.
portrait-professional.alt: Portrait of Shane Rainey, DO, pediatrician in Fort Worth, Texas
portrait-professional.permission: Dr. Rainey's approval of the final selection.

portrait-office.title: Dr. Rainey at Work in His Office
portrait-office.description: Candid, editorial photograph of Dr. Rainey at his desk or reviewing notes in his office. Natural light, uncluttered. No patient information visible on screens or paper.
portrait-office.crop: Horizontal 3:2. Dr. Rainey slightly off-centre; leave breathing room on one side.
portrait-office.alt: Shane Rainey, DO, working at his desk in his Fort Worth office
portrait-office.permission: Confirm no patient information is visible.

family.title: Dr. Rainey with His Family — Photography Needed
family.description: A relaxed, natural family photograph of Dr. Rainey with his wife and children, ideally outdoors in soft light. Only with the family's explicit permission for public use.
family.crop: Horizontal 3:2. Keep everyone inside the central 80% — edges may be cropped on phones.
family.alt: Shane Rainey, DO, with his wife and children
family.permission: Written approval from Dr. Rainey and his family. Children's names are never published.

with-patient.title: Dr. Rainey with a Young Patient
with-patient.description: A gentle, candid moment of Dr. Rainey with a child (and parent) during a visit — listening, explaining, or a stethoscope check. Warm, unposed.
with-patient.crop: Horizontal 4:3. Faces may be turned away if preferred.
with-patient.alt: Shane Rainey, DO, gently examining a young patient while a parent looks on
with-patient.permission: Signed photo release from the parent/guardian is REQUIRED before use.

waiting-room.title: Waiting Room
waiting-room.description: The waiting area as families will experience it: calm, tidy, naturally lit. No people, or only staff who have approved. Avoid signage belonging to other businesses.
waiting-room.crop: Horizontal 3:2, shot from the entry looking in at standing eye level.
waiting-room.alt: The calm, naturally lit waiting room at Dr. Rainey's Fort Worth office
waiting-room.permission: Building owner approval if shared space is visible.

exam-room.title: Examination Room
exam-room.description: A clean, welcoming exam room. Straightened, with no patient information visible.
exam-room.crop: Horizontal 3:2. Include the exam table and a window if possible.
exam-room.alt: A bright, welcoming pediatric examination room
exam-room.permission: Confirm no patient information is visible.

office-exterior.title: Office Exterior & Entrance
office-exterior.description: The building entrance at 4927 Byers Avenue as a family would see it on arrival, helping visitors recognise the right door. Avoid making another business's signage the focus.
office-exterior.crop: Horizontal 4:3, from the parking area or sidewalk. Entrance near the centre.
office-exterior.alt: Entrance to Dr. Rainey's office building at 4927 Byers Avenue, Fort Worth

detail-texture.title: Quiet Detail — Office or Outdoors
detail-texture.description: A calm detail image: a stethoscope on a wooden desk, sunlight across oak leaves, or a children's book on a shelf. Used as a supporting image beside article listings.
detail-texture.alt: Morning light across the leaves of a Texas live oak

intro-video.title: A Personal Introduction — Video
intro-video.description: A 60–90 second video of Dr. Rainey introducing himself, his philosophy of care, and how families can become patients. Filmed in his office or outdoors in natural light, with captions.
intro-video.size: 1920 × 1080 px MP4 (H.264), under 25 MB; poster image 1920 × 1080 JPG; captions as WebVTT
intro-video.crop: 16:9 landscape. Poster frame: Dr. Rainey looking toward the camera, mid-sentence, warm light.
intro-video.alt: Video: Shane Rainey, DO, introduces himself and his approach to pediatric care
intro-video.permission: Dr. Rainey's approval of the final edit. Captions required for accessibility.
